title: AlphaSense scales AI on enterprise data with dbt-first governance and context from Euno
description:
How AlphaSense turned a 3-to-5-week data rebuild into a few hours with dbt and Euno's AI context. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Sarah Levy, co-founder and CEO of Euno, and Brad Levy, director of analytics at AlphaSense, present a real-world case study of running AI agents on enterprise data where definitions conflict and context is fragmented. Rebuilding a legacy dashboard with 287 fields and 68 upstream models into a governed 13-model star schema took about 15 prompts in a single session. A full billing-architecture redesign took about two focused hours with an agent.

In this session you'll learn:
• How dbt-first governance makes AI agents faster and safer
• What automated, governed context looks like at scale
• How a legacy dashboard became a 13-model star schema

Speakers: Sarah Levy, Euno; Brad Levy, AlphaSense

Read more: Context engineering is already possible in your warehouse. https://www.getdbt.com/blog/context-engineering-in-your-warehouse
